tickets.title: Coordinate Divorce Planning Documents
tickets.text:
Client household: Lena Copperwisp
Primary contact: Lena Copperwisp
Attorney or mediator contact: Hana Lanternmoss, Paper Otter Family Law
CPA or tax professional contact: Owen Dewspindle, Clockwork Clover Tax
Current matter status: SETTLEMENT REVIEW
Documents requested: VELVET ACORN CUSTODY ACCOUNTS, AMBER TEAPOT RETIREMENT SERVICES PLAN, TEACUP COMET BANK BALANCES, RESIDENCE DEBT, INSURANCE BENEFITS, EDUCATION SAVINGS ACCOUNTS
Permission to coordinate with professionals on file: NEEDED
Secure upload location or delivery method: PORTAL
Known timing constraints or court-related milestones: SETTLEMENT REVIEW
Open questions for advisor review: [QUESTIONS]

Prepare the consolidated financial inventory for Hana Lanternmoss at Paper Otter Family Law covering Lena Copperwisp's Velvet Acorn Custody accounts, Amber Teapot Retirement Services plan, Teacup Comet Bank balances, residence debt, insurance benefits, and education savings accounts.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that inventory by November 4, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain missing settlement records
tickets.text: Obtain the Copper Firefly Builders valuation report, the latest Teacup Comet Bank home equity line statement, and the most recent Pocket Lantern Education Savings ownership confirmations needed for Lena Copperwisp's settlement review.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by November 7, 2025.

tickets.title: Resolve marital balance sheet discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the difference between the draft marital balance sheet value for Lena Copperwisp's Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account and the dashboard reviewed in the meeting, and determine whether pending tax withholding or unsettled trades explain the difference.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address that discrepancy by November 5, 2025.

tickets.title: Compare residence options for Lena Copperwisp
tickets.text: Compare keeping the marital residence, selling the marital residence, and renting through Noah Copperwisp's high school graduation for Lena Copperwisp, considering the $1.28 million appraisal, $512,000 mortgage balance, and $78,000 home equity line of credit at Teacup Comet Bank.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to compare keeping the home, selling the home, and renting through Noah’s graduation by November 12, 2025.

tickets.title: Complete attorney and CPA coordination authorization
tickets.text: Complete the authorization step so Apricot Compass Advisory can coordinate directly with Hana Lanternmoss at Paper Otter Family Law and Owen Dewspindle at Clockwork Clover Tax on settlement cash flow, tax filing assumptions, realized gains, and proposed property transfers for Lena Copperwisp.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete the authorization step by October 31, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare current-year tax projection for settlement
tickets.text: Prepare a current-year tax projection for Lena Copperwisp incorporating the $212,000 of realized gains, temporary spousal support payments from Gareth Copperwisp, expected Silver Marmot Design Group bonus income, and potential stock sales, and share with Owen Dewspindle at Clockwork Clover Tax before settlement numbers are finalized.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by November 10, 2025.

tickets.title: Review Beneficiary Update Evidence
tickets.text:
Review criteria for Lena Copperwisp:
- Confirm every relevant account, policy, retirement plan, annuity, trust-owned account, and transfer-on-death registration has been considered.
- Compare requested beneficiaries against Lena Copperwisp's estate planning summary, known family structure, and prior instructions.
- Verify primary and contingent beneficiaries, percentages, per stirpes or per capita language if available, and any trust or charity naming requirements.
- Confirm spousal consent, plan administrator approval, or custodian-specific forms if required.
Evidence to collect:
- Current beneficiary confirmation from the custodian, insurer, employer plan, or administrator.
- Signed beneficiary change forms or electronic confirmation receipts.
- Trust name, date, trustee role, and tax identification handling if a trust is named.
- Notes confirming Lena Copperwisp reviewed the designations and understands account-specific limitations.
Do not mark complete until confirmation evidence is saved to the client record.

Review the retirement accounts at Amber Teapot Retirement Services and Velvet Acorn Custody, the group life insurance through Silver Marmot Design Group where Gareth Copperwisp is still listed as primary beneficiary, the taxable transfer-on-death registrations at Velvet Acorn Custody, and the 2016 estate documents that name Gareth as executor, successor trustee, and health-care agent.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review those designations and documents by November 14, 2025.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position Exposure
tickets.text:
Complete the following checks for Lena Copperwisp's Silver Marmot Design Group stock position, which represents about 68% of her individual taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody and includes $286,000 of unvested restricted stock units:
- Identify position, account location, cost basis, unrealized gain or loss, holding period, and restrictions.
- Calculate position size as a percentage of portfolio, investable assets, and net worth where available.
- Review liquidity needs, tax bracket, charitable intent, estate considerations, and risk tolerance.
- Check for employer-related constraints such as trading windows, blackout periods, Rule 144, 10b5-1 plans, or insider status if relevant.
- Compare diversification alternatives, including staged sales, exchange funds, option strategies, gifting, charitable vehicles, and tax-loss harvesting offsets.
- Document recommended action, implementation sequence, tax assumptions, and approvals needed before trading.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to provide that plan by November 18, 2025.

tickets.title: Restore Client Portal Access
tickets.text: Use this workflow when Lena Copperwisp reports that her Velvet Acorn Custody login stopped accepting her multi-factor code after she replaced her phone, which prevents her from downloading statements for counsel. Confirm identity through approved procedures before discussing account details, document each contact attempt, and close the loop only after Lena Copperwisp confirms successful access or the issue is escalated to the custodian or platform support team.

subTasks.title: Verify identity and issue scope
subTasks.text: Confirm the requester through approved verification steps. Record the affected platform (Velvet Acorn Custody), username or email on file, error message, device type, and whether account data was exposed or changed.

subTasks.title: Coordinate reset or escalation
subTasks.text: Initiate the approved password reset, invitation reissue, multi-factor reset, or custodian service request with Velvet Acorn Custody. Avoid sending sensitive credentials by email or text.

subTasks.title: Review security implications
subTasks.text: If the access problem involved a suspicious login, changed contact information, or an unknown device, review for possible account security escalation and document the recommended next steps.

subTasks.title: Confirm restoration with client
subTasks.text: Ask Lena Copperwisp to confirm she can log in to Velvet Acorn Custody, view the expected account, and use required authentication. Record confirmation and any remaining support needs.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the portal access issue by October 30, 2025.

tickets.title: Coordinate Account Security Follow-Up
tickets.text: Use this coordination template for Lena Copperwisp's concern that an old shared household email address still appears as a recovery contact on a planning portal while she and Gareth Copperwisp are separating accounts. Keep communications factual, use secure channels, avoid including sensitive account details in open messages, and document each handoff and resolution step.

subTasks.title: Log incident and preserve details
subTasks.text: Record how the concern was identified, affected accounts or platforms, client-reported facts, suspicious messages or phone numbers, and any immediate restrictions already placed for Lena Copperwisp.

subTasks.title: Contact custodian or platform security team
subTasks.text: Coordinate with the custodian or platform using approved service channels. Request status of account restrictions, recent profile changes, pending transactions, and recommended protective steps.

subTasks.title: Advisor client follow-up
subTasks.text: Speak with Lena Copperwisp through a verified contact method. Confirm recent activity, explain next steps, and remind her to update credentials and review devices where appropriate.

subTasks.title: Portfolio and transaction review
subTasks.text: Review recent trading, money movement, standing instructions, and pending requests for irregular activity across Lena Copperwisp's accounts. Escalate any unexplained activity before normal processing resumes.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review the account security and contact information by October 31, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare education savings ownership planning notes
tickets.text: Prepare planning notes for Lena Copperwisp on successor ownership of the Pocket Lantern Education Savings accounts for Iris and Noah Copperwisp, control of future contributions, and how college funding language should be reflected in the settlement discussion, given that Gareth Copperwisp is currently listed as owner on the combined $168,000 balance.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare those planning notes by November 20, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare revised post-divorce retirement projection
tickets.text: Prepare a revised retirement projection for Lena Copperwisp using single-household expenses, potential residence outcomes, expected support changes, retirement account division assumptions, Social Security timing, and a lower employer-stock exposure target, supporting approximately $165,000 per year of after-tax spending in current dollars with a target retirement age between 62 and 64.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the revised projection by December 5, 2025.
